description: This file defines the 'MyReviewAPI' class, an API endpoint for managing performance review retrieval within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing reviews, with placeholders for other CRUD operations, and uses multiple traits and imported classes to handle permissions, responses, and data transfer objects.

classes.name: MyReviewAPI
classes.description: API class for listing and managing performance reviews associated with the authenticated user, extending core API endpoint functionality and implementing CRUD interface with only 'list' implemented.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of performance reviews for the authenticated user, applying sorting and pagination parameters, and returns the reviews along with total count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the query parameters used in listing reviews.
